2607.25672.title: AI's Capability in Assisting Scientific Research in Physics, Astrophysics, and Cosmology I: Literature Review
2607.25672.paper_summary: We investigate how well large language models (LLMs) can assist with literature reviews for scientific research. We perform a controlled study of eight expert-conceived research projects across the areas of physics, astrophysics, and cosmology. Each project has a defined background and goal, and human experts and AI prompters are asked to perform identical literature review tasks in parallel. We compare the relevant literature selected by humans with that selected by mid-2025 LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, ChatGPT Deep Research, and Gemini). We find the overlap between human- and AI-selected references to be small ($<$6\%), indicating that AI models do not yet reproduce a competent expert search on their own, though they have the potential to complement literature searches by humans. We then assess the reliability and completeness of AI-generated candidate references, distinguishing two types of hallucination: fabrications (references to nonexistent papers) and metadata mismatches (real papers with one or more incorrect fields). We find that while fabricated references make up 3\% of the AI-generated references, 64\% are real papers with at least one incorrect field (title, author, year, journal, DOI, or link), indicating that the mid-2025 models require systematic verification. However, the performance is significantly improved for the 2026 model ChatGPT Pro 5.5, with a single-project test showing zero fabrication or metadata mismatches.
2607.25672.paper_summary_zh: 我們調查大型語言模型（LLMs）在科學研究文獻回顧中的輔助能力。<lb/>我們對八個專家設計的研究項目進行了控制研究，這些項目涵蓋物理學、天體物理學和宇宙學領域。<lb/>每個項目都有明確的背景和目標，並要求人類專家和AI提示者平行執行相同的文獻回顧任務。<lb/>我們比較人類選擇的相關文獻與2025年中期LLMs（ChatGPT-4o、ChatGPT Deep Research和Gemini）選擇的文獻。<lb/>我們發現人類和AI選擇的參考文獻之間的重疊很小（$<$6\%），這表明AI模型尚未能獨立重現合格專家的搜索，儘管它們有潛力補充人類的文獻搜索。<lb/>然後，我們評估AI生成的候選參考文獻的可靠性和完整性，區分兩種類型的幻覺：虛構（對不存在的論文的引用）和元數據不匹配（真實論文中有一個或多個錯誤字段）。<lb/>我們發現，雖然虛構的參考文獻佔AI生成參考文獻的3\%，但64\%是真實論文，至少有一個錯誤字段（標題、作者、年份、期刊、DOI或鏈接），這表明2025年中期的模型需要系統驗證。<lb/>然而，2026年模型ChatGPT Pro 5.5的表現顯著改善，單一項目測試顯示沒有虛構或元數據不匹配的情況。
